title: MZ Looping Movie and VisuStella Extended Message Issues

posts.author: peachthyme
posts.body:
Hello,
I am looking for a way to play a looping movie with the message box and sprites in front of it, and the script provided in
this post
works how I want (I haven't found any other plugins that achieve this affect so if there exists one I would happily pay for it). However, whenever I open a menu (save/load/config) and then go back, the video ends. Without the Extended Message Plugin, I would not run into this issue as you cant open the menu while text is open. I also find that saving the game at the part the video is playing and then loading the game to that spot, the video is also no longer playing.
How should I go about getting the video to restart upon returning from a game menu? Is there a better way to go about this?
Thank you!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: You can hide the buttons with a plugin command. Or is it absolutely necessary for you to have them available in the scene(s) where there's a video playing?

posts.author: peachthyme
posts.body:
Ideally I would like it to have all the options available like other scenes.  If it's not possible or difficult to do with a video, I can try to make the video into into a gif instead since it looks like there are a few plugins to add looping gifs, or I could look into removing the Extended Message functions during those scenes, but I didn't realize that having text playing over a video was going to be such a complicated endeavor!
Also, I just realized I must have placed this with the wrong tag last night when I made the thread. I am working with RPG Maker MZ.

posts.author: peachthyme
posts.body:
I downloaded the lite version and tried it out. It seems that the process is as follows:
Preload video > Load Video > Play video.
I have to preload the video into the cache, load the video on to the layer, and then play it. The video does play in the background, but has the same issue where if I go to a menu it disappears. According to the documentation:
Code:
# Important! Difference between LoadVideo and PreloadVideo commands #
 LoadVideo - loads a video to the layer, and this video is only available on this map.
 When moving to another map, starting a battle, exiting to the menu, etc.
 the video will be cleared from memory!
 PreloadVideo - preloads the video into memory before the first call to LoadVideo with the same name,
 i.e. it will be stored between any maps, battles and other transitions.
 As soon as you call LoadVideo with the same name, the preloaded video will be
 placed on the specified layer and removed from the cache!
So using those plugin commands in that way wont work.
I thought maybe using the video as the map background would be a possible workaround, but I am not understanding how to get it to work. I have added the following to my maps notes ("RoadLoop" is a file of type .webm, which is placed in the /movies folder) but nothing is playing:
Code:
<videoParallax: RoadLoop>
Not sure if it wouldve been a viable work around but I wanted to give it a go anyway. Not sure what I am doing wrong
At this point I am willing to go the route to disable the menu buttons during the scene where the video is playing, but I dont know how to remove the Extended Messaging plugin buttons for that one scene only.
Edit: Visustella extended message plugin has a show/hide command. I think I will just disable the extended message buttons during that scene and if players have an issue with not being able to save during a short part they can just deal with it.
While I did not find a "solution" to the issue where videos disappear when menus are called, I think this thread can be marked as solved.
